verdict.rationale: Snyk Code is documented as a developer-first SAST tool that scans source code in real time across IDEs, repos, and CI/CD, showing source-to-sink flow visualization and prioritized findings, and the CLI (`snyk code test`) exposes this locally — this is exactly the SAST-for-vulnerability-classes capability the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming specific vulnerability classes like injection or XSS (docs describe generic 'vulnerabilities' rather than enumerating CWE categories) and independent/hands-on validation of detection accuracy for those specific classes.
